mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS trend and returns is below 0.1.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.5% in a 3-month window, it signals economic weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative returns in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained environment, a rising industrial production index above 105 signals recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: In supply-constrained regimes, INDPRO > 105 does not lead to positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPI) exceeds 240, it signals inflationary pressure that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 240.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over 6 months indicates labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS increases over 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts below 1000 thousand units signals weakening demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, HOUST < 1000 does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) signals a supply shock, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods of joint decline in INDPRO and GDPC1, S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.
